newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Physician Corp cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Physician Corp cut to hold.

text.p: -- Chicago Corp said it cut its rating on Physician Corp of America to a hold from a buy in light of the proposed acquisition of the firm by Sierra Health Services Inc .
-- On Monday, Sierra agreed to buy Physicians Corp in a stock deal valued at $421 million, offering 0.45 of its shares for each of Physician Corp's shares.

-- "We are lowering our rating on (Physician Corp) to a hold to be prudent in light of the merger, although we do not totally rule out a competing bid," Chicago Corp said in a report dated November 4.
-- Shares of Physician Corp, a managed health care company, were unchanged at 10-3/4.
